name: rust
description: Rust toolchain (stable 1.98.0, x86_64-pc-windows-gnu): cargo, rustc, rustdoc. Relocatable/portable (rustc resolves its sysroot from its own location). Building native binaries needs an external C linker on PATH (MSYS2 mingw gcc for the -gnu target).

cargo.description: Rust package manager and build system
cargo.usage:
cargo build --release # Build optimized
cargo run # Build and run
cargo test # Run tests
cargo add <crate> # Add a dependency
cargo install <crate> # Install a binary crate

rustc.usage:
rustc main.rs # Compile to main.exe
rustc --release -O main.rs # Optimized build
rustc --print sysroot # Show toolchain root
rustc --version # Show version

rustdoc.description: Generate HTML documentation from Rust source
rustdoc.usage: rustdoc src/lib.rs # Generate docs\ncargo doc # Preferred: generate docs for a crate
